achievements.name: Let's Get Started
achievements.description: Adopt your first animal

steps: Open the Animal Trading menu and buy any animal.
Place it into a completed habitat to adopt it.

achievements.name: The Future is Bright
achievements.description: Have your first baby animal born in your zoo

steps: House at least two compatible adult animals of the same species in a habitat with good welfare.
Wait for them to breed — the first live birth unlocks the trophy.

achievements.name: Earth, Wind and Water
achievements.description: Adopt an Aquatic, Avian and Terrestrial animal

steps: Adopt any Terrestrial species into a normal habitat.
Adopt any Aquatic species into an Aquarium habitat.
Adopt any Avian species into an Aviary habitat.

achievements.name: Student
achievements.description: Fully research a species

steps: Assign a Research Centre and vet/keeper to a species you keep.
Let research progress until the species reaches 100% on all research levels.

achievements.name: Worth Its Weight in Gold
achievements.description: Release an animal with Gold Genetics

steps: Breed or buy an animal whose genetics are rated Gold.
Select it and use the Release to Wild option from its info panel.

achievements.name: A Few More Hoses
achievements.description: Build an Aquarium habitat with a volume of 25 million litres

steps: Build an Aquarium habitat and keep enlarging it.
Watch the habitat's displayed water volume until it reads at least 25,000,000 litres.

achievements.name: Green Thumb
achievements.description: Plant 1000 trees in Wildlife Reserves

steps: Open a Wildlife Reserve and use the foliage/terrain tools.
Plant trees repeatedly across the reserve until the running total passes 1,000.

achievements.name: Full Tank
achievements.description: Have 5 different species in a single Aquarium

steps: Build one large Aquarium habitat.
Adopt five different aquatic species and place them all in that same aquarium.
Check the Zupedia Cohabitation Options so the species tolerate sharing the tank.

achievements.name: Budding Conservationist
achievements.description: Complete a Conservation Project

steps: Open the Conservation menu and start any Conservation Project.
Meet its requirements — usually releasing or breeding a set number of a species — until it completes.

achievements.name: Unbothered. Focused. Thriving.
achievements.description: Have 3 animal species Thriving at the same time in a zoo

steps: Fully research a species to reveal its Thriving requirements — they are hidden until research is complete.
Meet every requirement (terrain, plants, enrichment, food quality) until that species shows the Thriving status.
Repeat for two more species in the same zoo so all three are Thriving simultaneously.

achievements.name: Shared Accommodation
achievements.description: Place 5 different species in a single Terrestrial Habitat that all share a Thriving relationship

steps: Build one large Terrestrial Habitat (it must not be an Aquarium).
Fully research the candidate species so their Interspecies Enrichment is visible in the Zupedia.
Pick five species whose Cohabitation Options list each other with a Thriving relationship.
Adopt and place all five into that single habitat; all five must be Thriving at once.
warnings: Only a habitat that is not an aquarium counts, and all five species must cohabit — a Natural relationship is not enough, it has to be Thriving.

achievements.name: Follow Me!
achievements.description: Set up an Educational Tour

steps: Place an Education Tour point/stand near a habitat.
Assign a staff member to run the tour and start it.

achievements.name: Just In Case
achievements.description: Build an Aviary roof on a Habitat with a Penguin (Spheniscidae) or Pig (Suidae)

steps: Build a Terrestrial Habitat and place a Penguin or Pig species inside it.
Add an Aviary roof over that habitat using the roof tools.

achievements.name: They Do Move In Herds
achievements.description: Release a Release Group with more than 10 animals

steps: Gather more than 10 animals of a releasable species in your zoo.
Select them as a Release Group and release the whole group at once.

achievements.name: Job Well Done
achievements.description: Release 20 Release Groups

steps: Breed or buy animals in bulk across a long-running zoo.
Release them as groups rather than one at a time, and repeat until 20 groups have been released.

achievements.name: Metamorphose
achievements.description: Have a Walkthrough Exhibit with at least 3 different Butterfly (Lepidoptera) species

steps: Build a Walkthrough Exhibit.
Adopt three different butterfly species.
Place all three inside the same walkthrough exhibit.

achievements.name: Birds of a Feather
achievements.description: Have 5 different Avian species in a zoo

steps: Build one or more Aviary habitats.
Adopt five different avian species and house them all in the same zoo.

achievements.name: Sieve The Day
achievements.description: Reach a Filtration Rate of at least 5,000 in one filtration network

steps: Build an Aquarium habitat and connect water filtration equipment to it.
Add more filtration units to the same network until its combined Filtration Rate reaches 5,000 or more.

achievements.name: Mola Mola Likes You
achievements.description: Achieve 100% welfare with an Ocean Sunfish

steps: Adopt an Ocean Sunfish into a large Aquarium habitat.
Fully research the species to reveal all of its welfare requirements.
Meet every need — water volume, temperature, salinity, filtration and enrichment — until its welfare reads 100%.

achievements.name: Snap!
achievements.description: Take a Photo with a score of 10,000 in any Wildlife Reserve

steps: Enter any Wildlife Reserve and open the Photo mode.
Frame a subject well — close proximity, a clear view and good lighting raise the score.
Keep taking photos until one scores 10,000 or higher.

achievements.name: Naturalist
achievements.description: Establish 10 Ecosystems

steps: Open a Wildlife Reserve and work through its ecosystem objectives.
Establish each ecosystem (meeting its species and terrain requirements) until ten have been completed.

achievements.name: Paradise
achievements.description: Gain a 5-Star rating in a Wildlife Reserve

steps: Open a Wildlife Reserve and build up its animal welfare, ecosystem health and visitor experience.
Keep all ratings in the green and let the reserve run until the overall rating reaches 5 stars.

achievements.name: Lessons Learned
achievements.description: Achieve an Education Rating of 5 Stars on a non-Sandbox zoo

steps: Build a zoo in Career or Franchise mode (not Sandbox).
Place education boards, speakers and tours, and fully research species to unlock more education content.
Keep adding education coverage until the zoo's Education Rating reaches 5 stars.

achievements.name: Jungle Beat
achievements.description: Have 3 different Primate species in a zoo

steps: Adopt three different primate species.
House all three in the same zoo (they may share a habitat if compatible).

achievements.name: Long Distance Builder
achievements.description: Build 25km of barrier

steps: Build habitat barriers in any zoo.
Keep adding barrier fencing until the cumulative length built reaches 25 km.

achievements.name: Professor
achievements.description: Fully research 80 different species

steps: Set up Research Centres and keepers/vets researching your species.
Fully research one species at a time, rotating through as many distinct species as your zoos can hold.
Research levels carry across zoos in Career and Franchise, so spread the work — reach 80 fully researched species.

achievements.name: Bear-Able
achievements.description: Have 3 different Bear (Ursidae) species in the same zoo

steps: Adopt three different bear species.
House all three in the same zoo, each with a suitable habitat.

achievements.name: Credit Where It's Due
achievements.description: Receive the highest level Accreditation in any non-Sandbox hub

steps: Play in Career or Franchise mode (not Sandbox).
Improve your zoo's overall performance — animal welfare, conservation and guest satisfaction — to meet the accreditation requirements.
Apply for accreditation and reach the highest available level.

achievements.name: Ultimate Conservationist
achievements.description: Complete one Conservation Project of every type

steps: Open the Conservation menu and note each distinct project type available.
Complete a project of each type, one at a time — every completed project records its type.

achievements.name: Where Am I?
achievements.description: Drive 10km in the Research Vehicle

steps: Open a Wildlife Reserve and take control of the Research Vehicle.
Drive around while carrying out your normal reserve work until the odometer passes 10 km.

achievements.name: Conservation-aire
achievements.description: Earn 10,000 CC

steps: Earn Conservation Credits (CC) through breeding, releasing animals and completing conservation work.
Build your balance up to 10,000 CC.

achievements.name: They Grow Up So Fast
achievements.description: Have an animal born in your zoo reach 15 years of age

steps: Breed an animal in your zoo and keep it (do not sell or release it).
Maintain good welfare and let in-game time pass until that animal reaches 15 years old.
warnings: The animal must be born in your zoo and survive to 15 — selling, releasing or losing it resets the progress, and a long-lived species makes this much faster.

achievements.name: Did You Know?
achievements.description: Make every Education Topic for a species available in a zoo

steps: Fully research a species to unlock all of its education topics.
Place the education boards/speakers for that species so every one of its topics is available to guests.

achievements.name: Show-Pony
achievements.description: Start a Gold Tier (Level 3) Marketing for an animal

steps: Select an animal and open its Marketing panel.
Run marketing campaigns for it, upgrading through the tiers until you start a Gold Tier (Level 3) campaign.

achievements.name: Cats and Dogs
achievements.description: Have 2 different Canine (Canidae) and 2 different Feline (Felidae) species in a zoo

steps: Adopt two different canine species and two different feline species.
House all four in the same zoo, each with a suitable habitat.

achievements.name: First Steps
achievements.description: Have 10 critically endangered Terrestrial or Aquatic animals born in a single zoo

steps: Pick critically endangered Terrestrial or Aquatic species — avian species do not count.
House breeding pairs with excellent welfare and genetics to encourage births.
Keep breeding until 10 critically endangered animals have been born in that single zoo.
warnings: Avian species do not count, and all ten births must happen in the same zoo.

achievements.name: Good Start…
achievements.description: Achieve Bronze in all Career Scenarios

steps: Play through every Career scenario.
Meet each scenario's objectives well enough to earn at least a Bronze medal, then move on to the next.

achievements.name: Excellent Finish
achievements.description: Achieve Gold in all Career Scenarios

steps: Complete every Career scenario at Gold standard.
Pause at the start of each scenario to build efficient staff paths and facilities before funds drain.
Prioritise animal welfare and guest satisfaction so the scenario hits its Gold objectives before the timer expires.

achievements.name: Goodwin Park
achievements.description: Gain a 5-Star reputation in a zoo

steps: Build up a zoo in Career or Franchise mode.
Balance animal welfare, conservation and guest satisfaction, and keep all ratings in the green until the zoo's overall reputation reaches 5 stars.
